generations.name: Crafter-based (2019–present)
generations.note: Factory motorhome on the Crafter Mk2 (8-speed automatic, front-wheel drive; 4MOTION optional on the 680). 600 (6.0 m, 3.5 t, up to 4 berths with the optional cab bunk); 680 (6.8 m, 2 berths) is plated at 3.88 t in the UK, so needs a C1 licence. Four belted travel seats.
